purpose: Decide, by measurement rather than argument, whether the node-rule activation band or the initial connectivity <k0> is the dominant determinant of whether anything survives at all. The original AUTOGENESIS META-SEARCH start prompt defers rule search to Tier 3 as too expensive. Enumeration shows the band space at valence<=6 contains only 92 distinct rules, making it exhaustively searchable in minutes. If the band axis dominates, it must be promoted to Tier 1 and the original ordering revised.

hypothesis.H1: The node-rule band explains more of the variation in survival than initial connectivity does.
hypothesis.rationale: Under U0's band [1/6, 1/2] a degree-1 node can never activate, because its activation fraction is 0 or 1 and neither is inside the band. Measured consequence: ~98% of random sparse initial conditions go extinct within 3 steps. This suggests the band, not the physics constants, gates whether anything happens.

fixed.physics: U0 unchanged: r0=1, m=1, k_s=2, gamma=1, r_rep=0.75, k_rep=4, R_candidate=1.35, R_break=1.60, dt=0.02
fixed.note_on_cube_side: 3.0 rather than U0's 3.6 so that <k0> up to 4.0 is reachable at fixed geometry; density is held CONSTANT across the whole sweep so that k0 is the only connectivity axis varying.

axes.node_rule_band: all distinct contiguous bands over the reachable activation fractions at valence<=6, enumerated by autogenesis.rules.enumerate_bands -> 92 rules including the empty band. birth band and survival band are held EQUAL to each other, as U0 has them; the birth!=survival space is a separate, larger axis and is out of scope for this pilot.
axes.note_on_k0: All eight values are reachable at this geometry (verified: requested == achieved up to 4.0, saturating at 4.47). achieved_mean_degree is recorded per run and must be checked, never assumed.

seeds.note: The smoke namespace is for wiring checks only and its results may never be used in the decision. Confirmation of any lead from this pilot requires a fresh holdout namespace not listed here.

metrics.primary_class: one of EXTINCT / RUNAWAY / FROZEN / PERIODIC / RICH, assigned by autogenesis.metrics.screen
metrics.survival_rate: fraction of seeds classified FROZEN, PERIODIC or RICH
metrics.non_trivial_rate: fraction classified PERIODIC or RICH (a frozen crystal survives forever and is inert; it must not count as success)
metrics.log_persistence: log(last_step), defined for dead runs too so the dead region carries a gradient
metrics.classification: FROZEN = 1 distinct discrete signature in the trailing 128 steps; PERIODIC = 2..16; RICH = >16

controls.R000_EMPTY: band selecting no fraction. No node can ever activate. Everything must die at step 1. If it does not, the engine is broken.
controls.R013: band [0,1]. Every node with degree>=1 is active regardless of its neighbours, i.e. the state dynamics are switched OFF. This is the NULL-RULE arm: whatever survives here survives on mechanics alone. A real rule's persistence is only meaningful insofar as it differs from this.

decision_rule.band_effect_B: for each k0, the range (max-min) of the metric across rules; B = median of those ranges over the eight k0 values
decision_rule.connectivity_effect_K: for each rule, the range of the metric across the eight k0 values; K = median of those ranges over rules
decision_rule.exclusion_reason: the empty band is 0 by construction, not by measurement; including it would manufacture band spread. R013 (null rule) IS included, because it is a legitimate rule as well as a control.
decision_rule.otherwise: NEITHER_DOMINATES -- treat both as Tier 1 axes
decision_rule.consequence_if_BAND_DOMINATES: promote the node-rule band from Tier 3 to Tier 1 in SEARCH_SPACE_V1 and record the revision in docs/DECISIONS.md
decision_rule.consequence_if_CONNECTIVITY_DOMINATES: the original start prompt's Tier ordering stands; retract the proposal to promote rule search

labels.reason: This is DISCOVERY-track work on a self-chosen metric. No result from this pilot may be labelled [VALIDATED] or [SUPPORTED]. Confirmation requires a preregistered confirmatory protocol and a fresh seed namespace.

out_of_scope: any claim about memory, signal transfer, computation or autonomy
